owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
identity_rules: Bind Stripe customer/subscription to authenticated CreatorHub member server-side.
Explicitly bind Discord user ID through authenticated, CSRF-protected OAuth or an equivalent verified linking flow. Never infer Discord identity from email.
Resolve approved Google Drive principal separately. Grant only approved tier folders; never grant master-library access.
Client success redirects never grant access.
lifecycle_rules: Verify Stripe webhook signatures; durably deduplicate event IDs and reconcile current subscription state before applying transitions.
Cancel-at-period-end retains access until the paid-through boundary; a cancellation request alone must not revoke paid access.
Upgrade or downgrade applies at the actual effective billing boundary. Reconcile Drive and Discord independently with retryable audited jobs.
Failed payment follows an explicitly approved grace policy; unpaid initial checkout grants no paid access.
Revoke only membership-derived grants. Preserve separately purchased perpetual licenses and unrelated roles or Drive permissions.
Resubscribe reconciles the current verified identity and tier; stale webhook retries cannot restore expired grants.

certification_evidence.remaining_gate: Automated paid Discord-role reconciliation + controlled full subscription lifecycle certification
